opcode.name: START_AUDIO_PATH
opcode.comments: The purpose of start Voice Path command is to perform all required resets and configuration for voice modules and the vocoder before running voice tasks.

opcode.name: END_AUDIO_PATH
opcode.comments: END_VOICE_PATH is to perform all required procedures for ending the voice conversation.

comments.text: Handover start is used for temporary pause in conversation (hand-over).
Handover end is used in order to exit (Handover start) mode.

opcode.name: VOICE_RX_PACKET
opcode.comments: The host will send the RxPacket to the DSP by using this command. This command will drive both Rx and Tx activities.

opcode.name: VOICE_TEST_CONTROL
opcode.comments: The Voice Test Control command should help configure the voice shell in order to execute special tests (such as PCM and vocoder loop) or help debugging by sending the drift report.

comments.text: Codec drift compensation mechanism is enabled
Codec drift compensation mechanism is disabled
Drift report message is not send

unit.name: Send Rx Packet for debug purposes
Send debug report (voice control word status and frame energy)
Send Echo Canceller and RES dedicated Voice debug report

opcode.name: SELF_INVOCATION
opcode.comments: The Voice Test Control command should help configure the voice shell in order to execute special tests(such as PCM and vocoder loop) or help debugging by sending the drift report.
